structure.title: Preliminary Pages
structure.description: Introductory pages before the main body. Numbered in lower case Roman Numerals at the bottom center.

subsections.title: Title Page
subsections.guidance_notes: Follow the university's prescribed format for the title page.

subsections.title: Approval/Certification Page
subsections.guidance_notes: Standard certification of originality and supervisor's approval.

subsections.title: Dedication
subsections.guidance_notes: A brief dedication.

subsections.title: Acknowledgements
subsections.guidance_notes: Recognize individuals and organizations that assisted.

subsections.title: Table of Contents
subsections.guidance_notes: Detailed list of chapters and sections.

subsections.title: List of Tables
subsections.guidance_notes: If applicable.

subsections.title: List of Figures
subsections.guidance_notes: If applicable.

subsections.title: List of Appendices
subsections.guidance_notes: If applicable.

subsections.title: Abstract
subsections.guidance_notes: Single spaced summary, not more than 500 words.

structure.title: Chapter 1: Introduction
structure.description: Sets the background for the research.

subsections.title: Background to the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Overview of research area and motivation.

subsections.title: Statement of the Problem
subsections.guidance_notes: Clear description of the issue being addressed.

subsections.title: Purpose of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: General and specific objectives.

subsections.title: Significance of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Who benefits and how.

subsections.title: Scope of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Boundaries (geographical, content, time).

subsections.title: Research Questions
subsections.guidance_notes: Specific questions the study seeks to answer.

subsections.title: Research Hypotheses
subsections.guidance_notes: Optional/Field dependent. Null hypotheses to be tested.

subsections.title: Conceptual Framework
subsections.guidance_notes: Definitions and relationships between core concepts.

subsections.title: Theoretical Framework
subsections.guidance_notes: Theories upon which the study is anchored.

subsections.title: Empirical Studies
subsections.guidance_notes: Review of previous related research works.

subsections.title: Summary of Literature Review
subsections.guidance_notes: Highlighting the gap the current study intends to fill.

subsections.title: Design of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: e.g., Descriptive Survey, Experimental, Quasi-experimental.

subsections.title: Area of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Geographical location where the research is conducted.

subsections.title: Population of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Total group of individuals/items of interest.

subsections.title: Sample and Sampling Techniques
subsections.guidance_notes: The subset selected and the method used (e.g., Random, Stratified).

subsections.title: Instrument for Data Collection
subsections.guidance_notes: Tools used (e.g., Questionnaire, Interview Schedule).

subsections.title: Validation of the Instrument
subsections.guidance_notes: Check for face and content validity.

subsections.title: Reliability of the Instrument
subsections.guidance_notes: Consistency testing (e.g., Cronbach's Alpha).

subsections.title: Method of Data Collection
subsections.guidance_notes: Steps taken to distribute and retrieve instruments.

subsections.title: Method of Data Analysis
subsections.guidance_notes: Statistical tools used (e.g., Mean, SD, T-test, ANOVA).

subsections.title: Presentation of Results
subsections.guidance_notes: Orderly presentation according to research questions/hypotheses.

subsections.title: Discussion of Findings
subsections.guidance_notes: Interpretation in relation to literature reviewed.

subsections.title: Summary of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Brief overview of the entire work.

subsections.title: Conclusion
subsections.guidance_notes: Final thoughts based on the findings.

subsections.title: Recommendations
subsections.guidance_notes: Practical steps suggested based on the results.

subsections.title: Limitations of the Study
subsections.guidance_notes: Challenges encountered that might affect findings.

subsections.title: Suggestions for Further Research
subsections.guidance_notes: Areas for future investigators to explore.

subsections.title: Font and Spacing
subsections.guidance_notes: Font: Times New Roman, 12pt. Line Spacing: Double (2.0) for body, Single for Abstract/long quotes.

subsections.title: Margins
subsections.guidance_notes: Left: 1.5 inches; Right, Top, Bottom: 1.0 inch.

subsections.title: Referencing
subsections.guidance_notes: APA 7th Edition style.
